request.text: Walk me through making a pull request, step by step.

reply.raw:
A pull request asks the people who maintain a project to review your changes before they're merged in. Here's the route.

```card
{"title":"Making a pull request","heading":"Branch, commit, push, open, review","layout":"steps",
"items":[{"label":"Create a branch","note":"a separate copy for your work","icon":"arrow.triangle.branch"},
{"label":"Commit changes","note":"save your edits with a message","icon":"square.and.pencil"},
{"label":"Push the branch","note":"upload it to the remote","icon":"arrow.up.circle"},
{"label":"Open the PR","note":"pick base and compare branches","icon":"arrow.triangle.pull"},
{"label":"Describe it","note":"say what changed and why","icon":"text.alignleft"},
{"label":"Review and merge","note":"answer feedback, then merge","icon":"checkmark.seal"}],
"chips":["What does a commit message look like?","What if main changed meanwhile?"]}
```

Step 1: from the project's folder, run `git checkout -b my-fix` (use a name that describes your change). This gives you a branch, so your work stays apart from the main line of code. Have you got the project cloned on your Mac yet?
